description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractErrorResponseAdapter' which provides mechanisms to map ErrorResponse objects to and from a generic 'Adaptable' representation, particularly for the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles parsing error JSON objects, constructing Adaptable responses, and requires subclasses to implement specific methods related to topic path building and error response creation.

classes.name: AbstractErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class for mapping ErrorResponse objects to and from an Adaptable, handling JSON parsing, header translation, and topic path construction, meant to be extended with specific implementations.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an ErrorResponse of type T by parsing headers, payload, and error JSON.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an ErrorResponse object into an Adaptable representation, constructing topic paths, payload, and headers based on the error response and channel.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a TopicPathBuilder based on the error response; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to construct an ErrorResponse of type T given a topic path, exception, and headers; must be implemented by subclasses.
